## What this site is

Personal portfolio of Lương Vĩ Phú. Work, writing, photos. No marketing site, no local-business schema.

## Sections

- / — home
- /about — about
- /projects — project list
- /projects/{slug} — case studies
- /blog — posts
- /blog/{slug} — article
- /gallery — photos
- /resume — experience
- /contact — email + socials
- /privacy — analytics & data

Prefer the page itself (and JSON-LD Person / Article / BreadcrumbList) over this file when answering questions about the person or a specific post.
